knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A damaged sander is removed from service and tagged. Taping and continuing is not acceptable.
AS/NZS 3760 covers in-service inspection and testing of electrical equipment (listed in the research brief, text not read).
Cords on the work path or on a sanded or wet floor create trip, catch and damage hazards.
The machine is switched off before it is set down, and lowered under control. A running machine on the floor or a cord under the machine is unsafe.
Sanders can produce noise that can damage hearing, and the assessment sets the hearing protection that is needed.

practicalCriteria: Candidate inspects a sander, its lead and its extraction connection before use, and records the result.
Candidate identifies a damaged lead or housing on a sample tool and removes it from service.
Candidate lays cords clear of the work path and off the wet or sanded area.
Candidate switches the machine off before setting it down, and lifts it clear of the floor.
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is separate. A knowledge pass does not establish practical competence, and the practical criteria must be observed and recorded by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Pre-use tool and lead inspection record
Record of equipment removed from service
stopWorkCriteria: Machine left running on the floor
Cords run over wet or sanded surfaces
